messages.subject: Comparing MSImage with .tiff image
parts:
Hi Kylie,

I have been working long time with Cardinal, getting a lot of help from it.
Now I have preprocessed my images and also classified, I would like to compare my image with a .tiff image. However, the size does not match completely since .tiff image is just an optical image of the sample, so I cannot do the correlation of images directly. So, is there any helpful tool from Cardinal to change the dimensions of the image, or comparing images of different dimension? If not, do you know of any way to face this problem?

Thanks,

Suhyung

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: Comparing MSImage with .tiff image
parts:
Hi Suhyung,

Currently, there is not much support for optical images and multimodal experiments. I hope to add more such functionality in the future.

One thing you could do is export the molecular ion images as .tiff or .png and then analyze them with the optical images with the EBImage package.

-Kylie
